verdict.rationale: Honeybadger exposes a real API (error reporting, deployment notification, source maps, fault listing/detail) and even an MCP server letting an AI agent manage projects, investigate errors, and run BadgerQL queries, showing meaningful API-driven parity for core workflows. However, no OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (404s), and there's no evidence the API/MCP covers UI-only actions like resolving/reopening errors, configuring alarms, anomaly detection settings, or SAML/team management — missing for 10: OpenAPI spec confirming full endpoint coverage, API/MCP support for resolve/reopen and alarm configuration, and parity for admin/settings features shown only in UI docs.
